def order_by_points(nums)
  nums.each_index.sort_by { |i| [digit_sum(nums[i]), i] }.map { |i| nums[i] }

def rounded_avg(n, m)
  return -1 if n > m
  sum = (n..m).sum
  count = m - n + 1
  q = sum / count
  r = sum % count
  twice = 2 * r
  if twice < count
    result = q
  elsif twice > count
    result = q + 1
  else
    result = q.even? ? q : q + 1
  end
  "0b" + result.to_s(2)
end

def check_dict_case(dict)
  return false if dict.empty?
  keys = dict.keys
  all_lower = keys.all? { |k| k.is_a?(String) && k == k.downcase }
  all_upper = keys.all? { |k| k.is_a?(String) && k == k.upcase }
